A pure white starsilk wedding gown overlaid with black rose lace skirts is a piece of Shadowplay Garb.  It is currently unlocked to Tier 4 of 4.

At Tier 2, the gown gains the ability to shift from light to dark when certain spells are cast at it.  It will also trap CURTSY or BOW and TILT.
At Tier 3, it will trap RUB and SPIN.
When fully unlocked to Tier 4, it will trap FOLD and PULL.

When altering this piece of garb, you will need to provide a neutral 15/15/15, a dark 15/15/15, and a light 15/15/15.  The same is true for long descriptions.  If the garb has a look description, it must be appropriate for all three phases and must accompany long descriptions.

The neutral form is just like any regular garb alteration.  In all forms, the material and style should remain consistent.
This gown's description can be changed by casting appropriate spells at it.  It can be turned back into its neutral form by using the DUSTverb.

Neutral:
Base: a starsilk,wedding,gown

Dark:
Base: a shadowy,wedding,gown

Light:

This is a sorcerer's rune book for recording the runic representations of the unique magical pattern of each particular room in Elanthia.  Once entered into the book, the sorcerer can DRAW the pattern to use as a target for Planar Shift (740).

Sorcerers can add new room targets to the book using SENSE PATTERN in the room.  TURN/FLIP will turn to the next page or flip back to the previous.  TAP will select the next rune on the page and POKE will select the previous.  RUB twice to delete a pattern.
To display the description of the target room of the selected pattern, WHISPER BOOK SHOW PATTERN [#].
A bard may be able to reveal the owner of this book, if there is one.
This tome is one of the Book Buddies!  It currently has INSECT style messaging.

Book Buddies can be animated using TOUCH.  When it is animated, use SNAP to have it land on a bookstand alongside you.  (moves to inventory alongside).  SNAP again to animate it then TOUCH to return it to normal form.  When animated you can PROD it to toggle ambient messaging on or off.

Any merchant who is comfortable handling your Book Buddy is free to do regular base and long alterations. It can be a book, tome, grimoire, magnum opus, opus, volume, manual, textbook, booklet, codex, compendium, lexicon, folio, enchiridion, journal, prayerbook, or encyclopedia.
Any merchant can change the style of the messaging or make changes to custom fields 1 - 5.  They must make sense for the style.  The current custom settings are:
1 = "insect wings"  -  Limbs.  wings/legs/arms etc.  No more than 30 characters.
2 = "flies"  -  Movement.  moves/flies/walks etc.  1 word.
3 = "a bookstand"  -  Bookstand.  Full 15/15/15.  Must be a bookstand or something similar like a podium.
4 = "pages"  -  Pages.  Can have an adjective.  Must be some sort of paper, vellum, etc.  No more than 30 characters.
5 = "flying"  -  Movement ending in -ing. moving/flying/running etc.  1 word.

raw: Resembling a transparent fairywing berry-hued moth, the damask of the cloak features grey-shot indigo checkering along the lower edge of the berry-hued forewings and aqua dots edging the corbeau hindwings.  Polychromatic sparkles reflect off the wings of the cloak.  The cloak's interior has several pockets, ties, and straps to hide items away.

Analysis of a fairywing moth cloak of berry-hued damask indicates the creator has provided the following information:
~*~ Moth Cloaks ~*~

This cloak is a butterfly/moth cloak with several randomizing points to create multiple unique looks with a single PUSH.  It is Tier 5 out of 5, and it is set to the moth setting.  It is set to NOT rotate with day/night changes.  You can APPROVE to toggle this setting.
The cloak features an encumbrance reduction (3x/day, 15 minutes each RUB, resets at midnight server time.  There are 3 charges left today.
Utilities:
* APPROVE:  rotates through "moth only," "butterfly only," or "adjust with day/night"
* CLEAN:  will clear the selected, stored look
* POKE: takes your randomized look and saves it in 1 of the 2 available stored slots
* PUSH - replaces your randomized look
* TURN - rotates through all saved looks (current randomized look, any stored randomized looks, the custom look, if applicable)
* RUB - activates the encumbrance reduction.
Unlocked Fluff Verbs:  observe, tickle, eat, flip, hug, raise, bow, curtsy, brush, touch, and wave
*  WAVE has some "drama llama" options for you!  Try WAVE CLOAK WITH (anger, drama, joy, mystery, or sorrow)
Alterations:
* Base:  must be simple, as it carries across all looks.  The noun must be in the hooded cloak family.
* Material:  must be a type of cloth.  This carries across all looks.
* Colors cannot be referenced in the base or material fields, as colors change based on the settings.
* Custom settings:  The alter points must be provided in this specific order:

** "butterfly adjective^wingtype^forewing color^forewing marking^forewing marking color^forewing marking location^hindwing color^hindwing marking^hinding marking color^hindwing markinglocation^special*moth adjective^wingtype^forewing color^forewing marking^forewing marking color^forewing marking location^hindwing color^hindwing marking^hinding marking color^hindwing marking location^special
** The total character count must be 511 or less
** Moth/Butterfly Adjective alter point must be 15 characters or less.  No a/an needed.
** See the wiki for in-depth information and examples at https://gswiki.play.net/Moth_Cloak
* Custom Look 1 (Butterfly):  You can provide a SHOW for your custom setting.  It cannot contradict the alter points selected for the custom settings.
* Custom Look 2 (Moth):  Same as butterfly, but for the moth version.

* Doing a custom setting is 1 alteration service, as is each custom look (so a custom setting, butterfly look, and moth look are 3 separate alterations.  This is because each one is fairly intricate).
* The base/material can be done by a merchant separately or at the same time as one of the custom alterations.
*  It is up to the individual merchant if they wish to work on these items.
Current Settings:

flashy^narrow-winged^lavender-grey^bars^gradient grey^located haphazardly along the^blue-grey^rings^ebon^edging the^The voluminous hood of the cloak is lined with the feathery impressions of antennae.*transparent^fairywing^berry-hued^checkering^grey-shot indigo^along the lower edge of the^corbeau^dots^aqua^edging the^Polychromatic sparkles reflect off the wings of the cloak.
~*~End Custom Analyze~*~
